The separate monosyllable joy sits under the third D4 quarter, and and under the G4 onset of the final G4/E4 beamed pair. Encode n3 joy and n4 and as single. The unhyphenated wonder, run spans the first E4/G4 quarters and does not directly supply a syllable split; leave n1-n2 absent. No extender is inferred for n5.

The opening we aligns with C5 quarter n1; but aligns with D5 eighth n2 at the start of the first beamed pair. These two onsets are separately legible. The following see and thy run is compact and offset from the later centers; this pass does not claim a certain n3-versus-n4 see onset, thy onset, or continuation spans. Encode only we/single n1 and but/single n2; leave n3-n6 without lyrics.
